approved_scope: Seven instructional composition families and Paragraph 001 family selection; no art/story/render/publication approval.

selection_contract.rule: Classify by what the paragraph teaches, before considering aesthetic appearance or panel geometry.
selection_contract.source_of_truth: The exact paragraph text in the pinned Candidate 006 manuscript, not a conversational paraphrase.
selection_contract.approval: Human acceptance is required for each art and story candidate; classification does not approve artwork or the eventual slide.
selection_contract.uncertainty: If passage purpose is ambiguous, mark NEEDS_EDITORIAL_REVIEW, avoid invented datasets, and withhold visual generation.

families.name: Photographic Editorial
families.purpose: Introduce experiences, consequences and real-world people or settings
families.mandatory: Primary photorealistic original scene with an interpretable human situation; no botsy icon art
families.do_not_use_when: Paragraph primarily requires precise step logic or numerical evidence.

families.name: Visual Storyboard
families.purpose: Illustrate sequential events and contrast before/after decisions
families.mandatory: Each frame represents distinct manuscript-supported state; do not invent intervening events
families.do_not_use_when: Single frozen scene communicates the point more efficiently.

families.name: Consulting-Grade Diagnostic
families.purpose: Dissect business problems, contrasting hypotheses and decision consequences
families.mandatory: Clear, grounded problem framing and disciplined contrast; never imply unverified measurements
families.do_not_use_when: No analysis or structured comparison is supported by the paragraph.

families.name: Workflow & Process
families.purpose: Explain procedural stages, handoffs, escalation and gates
families.mandatory: Ordered state transitions and accountable actors; source-grounded meanings
families.do_not_use_when: Paragraph introduces a question before explaining a process.

families.name: Evidence & Data
families.purpose: Present verifiable findings, comparisons, audit results and measured outcomes
families.mandatory: Every displayed quantity must come from a cited or pinned factual source, or be explicitly labeled fictional/example
families.do_not_use_when: No dataset or evidence supports a chart or numeric dashboard.

families.name: Technical Architecture
families.purpose: Illustrate systems, components, interfaces, structural geometry and controls
families.mandatory: Precise labeled architecture with correct interfaces; use independently editable technical SVG in production
families.do_not_use_when: Paragraph is about human experience rather than implementation.

families.name: Decision & Application
families.purpose: Turn a lesson into a learner action, diagnostic exercise or structured choice
families.mandatory: A clear learner question, options or rubric and room for response; do not reveal answer prematurely
families.do_not_use_when: Paragraph is a narrative premise without a learner exercise.

calibration_case.hypothesis: A tired but capable professional finishes a workweek with a record of completed tasks while an important project is visually stalled.
calibration_case.rationale: Paragraph 001 opens with a lived professional experience and ends with the diagnostic question of many tasks versus negligible progress.
